A lei americana te protege — conheça seu: U.S. law protects you — know your rights
Os trabalhadores H-{#}B e H-{#}A têm dir: H-{#}B and H-{#}A workers have solid labor rights, guaranteed by the U.S. Department of Labor. Do not be afraid to claim your rights.
Você deve receber pelo menos o salário m: You must receive at least the state minimum wage or the rate stated in your contract — whichever is higher.
Horas além de {#} semanais devem ser pag: Hours beyond {#} per week must be paid with a {#}x premium (in states that require it — check your state's rules).
No programa H-{#}A, o empregador é obrig: Under the H-{#}A program, the employer is required to provide free or affordable housing near the workplace.
Em muitos casos o empregador é responsáv: In many cases the employer is responsible for covering your transportation back to your home country when the contract ends.
Acidentes de trabalho são cobertos pelo: Workplace injuries are covered by the employer's insurance. Injuries outside of work vary depending on the contract.
Você não pode ser discriminado por nacio: You cannot be discriminated against based on nationality, race, sex, or religion. American labor laws apply to everyone.
Você tem direito a receber uma cópia do: You have the right to receive a copy of your employment contract with all conditions: salary, job role, schedule, and duration.
Se seu empregador não cumprir as obrigaç: If your employer does not meet their obligations, you can report them to the DOL (U.S. Department of Labor) without fear of retaliation.

Preciso saber inglês para tirar o visto: Do I need to know English to get the H-{#}B or H-{#}A visa?
Vagas como paisagismo, colheita, constru: Jobs such as landscaping, harvesting, construction, hospitality, and kitchen work generally do not require fluent English. During the consulate interview, you can answer in Portuguese — interpreters are available. However, the more English you know, the better your experience in the U.S. and the greater your chances of landing a higher-paying job.
Tenho visto negado no passado. Posso ten: I was denied a visa in the past. Can I try for the H-{#}B?
It depends on the reason for the denial.
Se foi por falta de vínculos no Brasil (: If it was due to a lack of ties to Brazil (tourism), the H-{#}B has an advantage because you go with a work contract and a scheduled return date — which shows clear ties. However, denials for document forgery or other serious problems can jeopardize future applications. Consult an immigration attorney if you have a history of denials.
